assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production background for a Chinese casual card game on Nintendo Switch, wide 16:9 landscape. Create a polished premium 3D illustrated game environment, high quality rendered materials and cinematic lighting. Rich warm gold versus emerald, sophisticated inviting night atmosphere. Composition: fixed seated player camera, a very broad empty poker table fills the entire lower 72 percent of frame, table edge begins near upper 28 percent, environment visible across the top and far left/right. No UI, no frames around the image, no text, no logos, no cards, no characters, no chips, no watermark. Unique standalone complete scene, not an atlas.
